text:
maria: quick heads-up — ran into a weird race where X-Req-Id pops back into logs after redaction when auth retry fires. reproducible in samples/node-local.

maria: repro steps:
```
DEBUG=redwood:telemetry node samples/telemetry-repro/app.js
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer invalid' http://localhost:3002/echo
```

kevin: can you paste the log lines?

maria: sanitized snippet:
```
2026-03-25T12:00:01.100Z info telemetry inbound scrub X-Req-Id: <redacted>
2026-03-25T12:00:01.130Z warn auth failed -> retry scheduled
2026-03-25T12:00:01.131Z debug retry-wrapper replay headers X-Req-Id=aa11bb22
2026-03-25T12:00:01.132Z info http response logged X-Req-Id=aa11bb22
```

ash: looks like retry is replaying a cached header snapshot created before OTEL scrub runs. which sdk/shim?

maria: node-sdk@1.8.4 + otel-shim@0.4.3. retry copies headers at attempt start; the inbound OTEL hook mutates req.headers afterwards.

telemetry-bot: alert: telemetry-redaction-suspect trace=0xdead (low). ticket RW-1200 created.

kevin: short-term: change retry to snapshot at replay time or call scrubbing inside retry before emit. long-term: define contract between OTEL shim and retry wrapper (scrub-before-snapshot or snapshot-from-live).

maria: i prototyped reading req.headers at replay-time — test added to samples/integration/telemetry-replay.test.js (fails on master, passes with change). will open PR with failing test + fix.

eng-platform: good — also add cross-SDK parity job (node + python) to catch these differences. RW-1201 to track. ping us when PR is ready for review.

kevin: thanks — also file a note in changelog: "fix(node): avoid replaying pre-scrubbed headers during auth retry" and alert security so they can close RW-1200 after verification.

maria: will do, thanks all.
